evals.name: simplify-go-api
evals.prompt: Refactor a bloated interface with 15 methods into idiomatic consumer-driven Go interfaces.
evals.expected_output: Small, single-method or focused interfaces defined by the consumer package.
assertions: Interfaces are split into small, cohesive interfaces (1-3 methods).
Interfaces are defined where they are used (consumer side).
Names follow Go convention (Reader, Writer, Closer or clear verb-based names).

evals.name: happy-path-control-flow
evals.prompt: Refactor deeply nested if-else statements validating a user request into idiomatic Go guard clauses.
evals.expected_output: Flat control flow with early returns on errors keeping the happy path left-aligned.
assertions: Errors are checked immediately with early return.
Happy path execution remains at minimal indentation level.

evals.name: pointer-vs-value-semantics
evals.prompt: Choose receiver types for a Money value object vs an Account aggregate with mutating methods.
evals.expected_output: Value receivers for immutable Money struct; pointer receivers for mutating Account aggregate.
assertions: Money uses value receiver (func (m Money) Add(o Money) Money).
Maintains consistency across all methods of each type.
